en.headline: Asia’s biggest professional pickleball event set for Kai Tak in October
en.dek: The PPA Asia 1500 Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam will run from 19 to 25 October at Kai Tak Arena with a record US$1.1 million purse and more than 860 players.
body: Hong Kong will host the largest professional pickleball tournament yet staged in Asia when the PPA Asia 1500 Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam takes place at Kai Tak Arena from 19 to 25 October.

Organisers said on Tuesday that the season-ending event will offer up to US$1.1 million in prize money—the highest in Asian professional pickleball history—along with 1,500 ranking points. More than 860 professional and amateur players have already registered, filling all available spots within two weeks of registration opening.

Kai Tak Arena will be fitted with 24 international-standard indoor courts. Local top-ranked player Wong Hong-kit is among those expected to compete on home soil, alongside other regional and international names. The Hong Kong, China Tennis Association is supporting the event.

Tickets go on public sale through HK Ticketing at 9 a.m. on 10 September, with priority booking for Hang Seng Visa cardholders from 4 September. A free-admission fan zone with interactive booths and merchandise will operate alongside the competition.

zh.headline: 亞洲最大職業匹克球賽10月啟德舉行 獎金110萬美元
zh.dek: PPA亞洲職業匹克球巡迴賽1500級別香港大滿貫將於10月19至25日在啟德體藝館上演，總獎金高達110萬美元，逾860人參賽。
body: 香港將於10月19至25日在啟德體藝館舉辦亞洲歷來最大型的職業匹克球錦標賽——PPA亞洲職業匹克球巡迴賽1500 • 恒生銀行香港大滿貫2026。
主辦方周二表示，這場賽季壓軸賽事總獎金高達110萬美元，創亞洲職業匹克球歷史新高，並提供1,500點排名積分。逾860名職業及業餘球手已報名，所有名額在開放後兩周內爆滿。
啟德體藝館將設置24個符合國際標準的室內賽場。港隊一哥王康傑等本地及國際球手料會參賽。賽事獲中國香港網球總會支持。
門票將於9月10日上午9時起於快達票公開發售，恒生Visa信用卡持卡人可於9月4日起優先購票。場內另設免費入場的球迷區，提供互動攤位及官方商品。
